commit.subject: lane: centralize dispatch configuration
commit.body:
Move the dispatch seed into ops/lane.conf and add a strict, non-evaluating Python reader with closure and literal checks. Wire the shell wrapper and launcher to the shared lane name, branch names, scope cap, wall, models, efforts, local overrides, and refusal contract.
